signIn.title: Sign in to Keigan
signIn.subtitle: Root causes in minutes, quieter alerts and healthy SLOs across your applications.
signIn.localModeDescription: These are test users. The Keigan API issues a short-lived local token.
signIn.chooseTestUserDescription: Each user has a different level of access, so you can try every role.
signIn.microsoftDescription: Use your MetLife account. Your access follows your SailPoint groups.
signIn.noTestUsers: No test users are configured in the Keigan API.
signIn.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
signIn.sessionRejected: Keigan couldn't verify your sign-in. Try again, or contact the Keigan team if it keeps happening.
signIn.apiUnavailable: The Keigan API isn't reachable. Start the backend on port 8000, then try again.
signIn.footer: Keigan suggests; people decide. Keigan never changes your systems.

brand.highlightRootCause: Root cause analysis in minutes, backed by evidence
brand.highlightNoise: Alert noise reduced to the groups that matter
brand.highlightSlo: SLO health and error budgets across every application
brand.highlightCommunications: Bilingual incident updates, ready to send

noAccess.title: You don't have access to an application yet
noAccess.description: Keigan only shows the applications you belong to. Access comes from SailPoint groups named after each application's code.
noAccess.readerGroupDescription: Read incidents, investigations, SLOs and knowledge, and chat with Keigan.
noAccess.adminGroupDescription: Everything a reader can do, plus onboarding, runbooks, SLOs and notifications.
noAccess.stepFindCode: Ask your team or the Keigan admins for the application code, for example CLMJP.
noAccess.stepRequestGroup: In SailPoint, request the reader group for read-only access, or the admin group to manage the application.
noAccess.stepSignInAgain: When the request is approved, sign out and sign in again.

bootstrap.errorDescription: The client configuration couldn't be loaded from the Keigan API.

profileError.title: Couldn't load your profile
profileError.description: Keigan signed you in but couldn't read your access. Try again in a moment.
